notifications.title: The weekly market scan doesn't cover Going Down
notifications.detail: market.yml only writes Paisa Panchayat's data to the market-data branch (last run 19 Nov). Going Down has search queries in channels/going-down/market.json, but nobody runs them. Research worked from manual YouTube searches tonight, which use up the nightly search budget.
notifications.fix: 1. Add a channel loop (or a CHANNEL input) to .github/workflows/market.yml that reads channels/<slug>/market.json queries for every active channel in config/channels.json. 2. Write each channel's result to its own file on market-data (e.g. going-down/market.json). Workflows are owner-only, so this needs you or an approved change.
